original_question: What are the extra bone pieces in the skull, also called intrasutural bones, observed in individuals with Hajdu–Cheney syndrome?

final_qi.question: What are the extra bone pieces in the skull, also called intrasutural bones, observed in individuals with Hajdu–Cheney syndrome?
final_qi.search_keyword: Hajdu Cheney syndrome intrasutural bones extra skull pieces
final_qi.long_answer: The extra bone pieces in the skull observed in individuals with Hajdu–Cheney syndrome are known as Wormian bones. These are additional, small, irregular bones that form within the cranial sutures. In the context of Hajdu–Cheney syndrome, their presence is significant as they indicate abnormal ossification associated with the osteolytic features of the disease.
